execution_script.description: Complete Python source for the execution transaction.

return_schema.description: JSON Schema for the model-facing result of the execution transaction.

kb_items.description: Canonical execution-KB record IDs associated with this contract. The list is the deduplicated union of KB records actually used to draft the contract and additional records associated after inspecting actions in the drafted script. Empty when no KB association is warranted.

semantics: Ask the model for the exact current user prompt.
Inject the mandatory prompt-to-goal KB entry and request a goal.
Inject the mandatory goal-to-query KB entry and request execution-KB queries.
Run the queries deterministically and expose compact selectable KB topic projections plus the mandatory topic-selection KB entry.
Resolve the model-selected topic IDs to their full canonical KB records.
Give the goal and full selected KB records to the model as the problem of constructing the instruction that should solve that goal under that KB context.
Require the model to return that solver instruction without solving the goal in the synthesis step.
Execute the synthesized instruction semantically to draft execution_script and return_schema, and require the model to identify only the supplied KB record IDs that materially informed the draft.
After the contract draft exists, inspect its concrete script actions and ask for additional execution-KB queries for topics that should be associated with the contract because of those actions.
Run those post-draft queries deterministically, expose selectable topic projections, and allow the model to select zero or more additional KB records.
Finalize contract.kb_items mechanically as the deduplicated union of records used to draft the contract and additional action-associated records.
Require the final model response to return the machine-finalized contract unchanged as result and choose the next transition.
The result is validated only by this transaction's return_schema.
The transition is consumed by the higher-level mode controller and is not part of the model-facing result.
The transaction receipt separately preserves which kb_items were used_to_draft versus associated_for_execution.
